I have been going in circles with Customer Support for a month now but still can’t get anyone to understand my issue.  I can’t even get a response from the Corporate Office after bringing my complaint to them. reviews.text: Temu is genuinely one of the most misleading shopping platforms I’ve come across, and people seriously need to be warned about how they operate. They make you believe you’ve unlocked 5 FREE gifts, only to wait until you’ve already committed to purchasing 2 items before revealing that the other 3 are supposedly free. Then, just when you think you’re finally about to receive those remaining 3 gifts, they hit you with another catch — you now have to purchase 2 MORE random items to claim what you were originally told was free. It’s an endless cycle of misleading promotions, hidden conditions and tricks designed to make you spend more money. They deliberately make you feel like you're one step away from getting your rewards, only to keep moving the goalposts. How can you advertise something as FREE when customers are constantly being forced to spend more money to actually receive it? In my opinion, it's an absolute scam, and I genuinely think everyone should be aware of these tactics before wasting their time and hard-earned money on Temu.

I purchased two Modern Style Bar Stools through Temu for SAR 415.77. Instead, I received a completely unrelated product: a bottle of BLECO Cleaner & Polish.

Despite providing clear photographic evidence of the original order, the incorrect product received, and the shipping label, Temu has failed to provide a satisfactory resolution.

The delivery company also marked the shipment as signed for, although I did not personally sign for it or receive it directly from the courier.

Instead of taking ownership of the customer experience and resolving the issue, Temu has repeatedly delayed the process and shifted responsibility between the seller and customer support.

This is not just a seller’s mistake anymore. It is a failure of Temu’s customer service and complaint resolution process.

Customers should not have to fight to get their money back after receiving something completely different from what they paid for.

I strongly urge potential buyers to think twice before purchasing through Temu and to keep evidence of every order and delivery.

Temu needs to take responsibility, not shift it to the customer.

If this remains unresolved, I intend to escalate the matter to the Better Business Bureau. Customers deserve better communication and service.

reviews.title: Free gifts claiming
reviews.text:
Temu attracts users with promises of FREE GIFTS, but the experience feels like a complete waste of time. They ask you to share referral links with friends on WhatsApp and other social media platforms, invite new users, and even get existing users to reinstall the app. After forwarding the link countless times and asking friends to help, when you are just ONE STEP away from claiming your free gifts, Temu suddenly asks you to share with ONE MORE FRIEND again and again!

How many people do you expect us to invite? Why advertise free gifts if you keep changing the requirements and never let users finish the process? This feels like a misleading trick to make people promote your app for free.

I wasted so much time, disturbed my friends with endless invitations, and got absolutely nothing in return. The whole process is frustrating, dishonest-looking, and completely unacceptable.

Temu, stop wasting people’s time with these endless referral tricks! If the gifts are genuinely free, make the rules clear and let users claim them fairly. Don’t keep moving the goalposts just when people are about to finish.

Yesterday I received a batch of 50 paint brushes plainly showing 1” on the metal binding but only measure just under 20mm and the laughable part is that there was more loose bristles in the delivery bag than there was in the brushes.  They went straight into my rubbish bin.  
Best tip I can offer is double read and study the description before buying especially delivery times as some items will be shipped overland from the other side of the planet.  
Happy shopping and be careful.
